text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Morocco bought 35,000 tonnes soft wheat on Wednesday at $186.75 to $189.50 per tonne C&F for delivery in the first half of October, an official at the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses said.

A first lot of 20,000 tonnes was purchased at $186.75 per tonne C&F for October 1-10 and The second lot of 15,000 tonnes was acquired at $189.50 per tonne C&F for delivery October 10-15. These quantities are U.S. and French optional wheat, he said.

WHEAT SALES - A Philippine flour mill bought 25,000 tonnes of U.S. dark northern spring wheat at $4.10 a bushel and 10,000 tonnes of western white wheat at $4.18 a bushel. The deal was made late on Tuesday for October delivery.
- CCC bought 25,000 tonnes U.S. HRW wheat under the export donation program to Bosnia at $177.64 a tonne for Oct 5-31 shipment.
- Algeria bought 100,000 tonnes of Canadian durum wheat at a September 12 tender for shipment between the second half of October and the first half of December. Traders had no pricing details.

BARLEY TENDER - Saudi Arabia will tender on September 20 to import a total of 1.72 million tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for delivery in October, November and December, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
SOYBEAN MEAL SALE - The CCC bought 5,000 tonnes U.S. soybean meal under the export donation program to Russia for September 30-October 15 shipment.

CORN SALE - The Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee on Wednesday bought 52,500 tonnes of Argentine corn in tender at $153.18 per tonne, C&F, traders said. Traders said Toepfer won the contract with shipment for May 21-June 10 from Argentina.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks up to 42,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat under the export donation program to Georgia. The shipment period is October 10-November 5 and offers are due by September 23.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 50,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale. September 17 was set to receive offers. Confirmation would be made on September 18, for Oct 15-Nov 14 shipment.
- Syria separately offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale for November shipment. October 1 was final date for offers. Confirmation is set on October 2.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks up to 4,410 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soft red winter or soft white wheat for donation to Senegal for October 5-31 and offers are due by Sept 18.
- The CCC seeks 45,000 tonnes U.S. HRW wheat to donation for Ethiopia for November 1-25 and offers due by Sept 19.
CORN TENDER - Jordan is to seek 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn for shipment in first half of November. Offers must be received by September 25.
- CCC seeks up to 4,280 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn to Angola. Shipment is for Oct 5-31 and offers due Sept 18.

CORN TENDER - The South African Maize Board was offering up to 33,000 tonnes of white corn for export in one unit of 20,000, 25,000 or 33,000 tonnes for shipment on October 23 to November 1, from Durban. The tender closes on September 25.
- CCC said it is seeking up to 16,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 or better yellow corn for donation to Rwanda. Shipment period is set for December 5-30 and offers are due by September 24.

CORN AND WHEAT TENDER - Nine South Korean feed mill companies, including Sunjin Feed Co Ltd and Je Il Feed Co Ltd, passed on tenders for 52,500 tonnes of corn and 52,000 tonnes of feed wheat due to high prices, traders said.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey will tender on Thursday to export at least 200,000 tonnes of barley for Oct-Dec delivery.

RICE TENDER - Forty-one exporters have tendered for 50,000 tonnes of rice for October/November delivery to Sri Lanka, the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The tender will be awarded during this week, CME said.
- The Republic of the Congo seeks to buy about 13,300 tonnes of U.S. long grain milled rice under the PL-480 Title I and offers are due by Wednesday. Shipment is for Nov 5-20.
SOYBEAN OIL TENDER - The Republic of the Congo seeks to buy 3,400 tonnes of PL-480 tonnes of soybean oil. Offers are due by Wednesday. Shipment is for November 5-20.
